title: image moderation review: reviewer and status are taken from the request body

criteria.given: a moderation-review request whose body carries a reviewed_by value
criteria.then: the stored reviewer is the session user's email and the body value is ignored; the route source never reads reviewed_by from the request body

criteria.given: a moderation-review request whose review_status is not in the allow-list
criteria.then: the endpoint answers 400 without touching the database
